subtasks.title: Install husky and lint-staged, add npm scripts
subtasks.description: Add husky@9 and lint-staged@15 as devDependencies via npm install. Add 'prepare' script for husky init, 'typecheck' script for tsc --noEmit, and lint-staged config to package.json. Run npx husky init to create .husky directory.
acceptance_criteria: npm run typecheck runs tsc --noEmit on the full project

subtasks.title: Create pre-commit hook for lint-staged
subtasks.description: Create .husky/pre-commit hook that runs npx lint-staged. The hook should exit with the same code as lint-staged so that failures block the commit.
acceptance_criteria: A staged TS file with a type error blocks the commit

subtasks.title: Verify and test the hook end-to-end
subtasks.description: Run tsc --noEmit to verify the project typechecks cleanly. Run npm run lint to verify lint passes. Test the pre-commit hook by staging a file and committing.
acceptance_criteria: git commit succeeds when all checks pass
